description: This file defines a NotificationHelper class that manages the creation of notification channels and displaying various types of notifications related to events, backup, restore, and migration processes within an Android application.

classes.name: NotificationHelper
classes.description: A helper class to create notification channels and show different notifications such as event reminders, backup/restore progress, and migration statuses.

methods.name: NotificationHelper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the notification channels.

methods.name: createNotificationChannels
methods.description: Creates notification channels for events and backup, if the Android version supports it.

methods.name: showEventReminder
methods.description: Displays an event reminder notification with a specified title and content.

methods.name: showBackupProgress
methods.description: Shows a notification indicating backup progress.

methods.name: showBackupComplete
methods.description: Displays a notification indicating the result of a backup operation, success or failure.

methods.name: showRestoreProgress
methods.description: Shows a notification indicating restore progress.

methods.name: showRestoreComplete
methods.description: Displays a notification indicating the result of a restore operation, success or failure.

methods.name: showMigrationProgress
methods.description: Shows a notification indicating migration progress.

methods.name: showMigrationSuccess
methods.description: Displays a notification indicating migration was successful.

methods.name: showMigrationError
methods.description: Displays a notification indicating migration error.

methods.name: hasNotificationPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has permission to post notifications, especially relevant for Android Tiramisu and above.
